data.id_column: Cell/sample id column in --input. Defaults to the first column.
data.stat_by: REQUIRED. One or more metadata columns whose level counts/percentages are plotted. Vector of column names.
data.group_by: Primary grouping column. If omitted, all rows form a single group.
data.split_by: Optional facet/split column. Produces one panel per level.
data.bg_by: Optional background grouping column. Adds a background grouping layer.
data.rows_include: Only keep these cell/sample ids (values in id_column).
data.stat_level: For venn/upset: the level within each stat_by column considered 'present'. A single value (applied to all) or one per stat_by column.
data.keep_na: Keep NA as an explicit level (statPlot keep.na).
data.each: Make one plot per group element instead of one combined plot (statPlot each).
data.force: Skip the >100-levels interactive prompt. Always TRUE in CLI mode.

plot_mode.plot_type: bar, rose, ring, pie, trend, area, dot, sankey, chord, venn, or upset.
plot_mode.position: stack or dodge (ggplot position for bar/trend/area).
plot_mode.combine: Combine multiple panels into one patchwork object (TRUE) or return a list (FALSE).
plot_mode.nrow: Patchwork rows when multiple panels are combined.
plot_mode.ncol: Patchwork columns when multiple panels are combined.

labels.title: Plot title.
labels.subtitle: Plot subtitle.
labels.legend_name: Override fill legend title (best-effort for single-panel ggplot outputs).
labels.show_label: Show value labels on the plot (statPlot label).

typography.font_family: Global font family (applied via theme.args where supported).
typography.x_axis_text_angle: X tick label angle (statPlot forces 45 for non-polar types).

colors.palette: Named palette from SCA paletteCustomize (e.g. npg, jco, Paired, Set1).
colors.palcolor: Named colors for stat_by levels (named vector).
colors.palcolor_bg: Named colors for background groups (statPlot palcolor.bg).

layers.aspect_ratio: Panel aspect ratio (statPlot aspect.ratio). Auto-set to 1 for rose/ring/pie.

annotations.highlight_levels: Reserved selector: levels to highlight (best-effort, applied where supported).

legends.legend_position: right, left, bottom, top, or none.
